description: Value in ISO8601 date and time format (such as 2025-10-07T10:35:00) is required.  While it is supported to set either DailyRecurrent or WeeklyRecurrent schedules, it is not supported to enable both settings simultaneously.  A reboot will be scheduled to occur every week at the configured day and time starting at the specified date and time. Setting a null (empty) date will delete the existing schedule.
